nodes.label: Fictitious Planet Orbital Elements Format
nodes.rationale: Each line holds 9 orbital elements: epoch (Julian day or J1900/B1950/J2000/JDATE), equinox, mean anomaly, semi-major axis, eccentricity, argument of perihelion, ascending node, inclination, planet name. Bodies are computed via swe_calc() with planet number ipl = SE_FICT_OFFSET_1 (39) + element-set number, e.g. Kronos = 43. Up to 960 fictitious planets; entries include Witte/Sieggruen planets, Nibiru, Harrington, Vulcan, Selena, Planet 9.
